title: Tom Holland Shares His Favourite Hobbies
description:
What keeps Tom Holland grounded?

In this episode, Tom sits down with Esquire to share the hobbies and habits that help him feel good. From his love of golf and tap dancing to his surprisingly simple approach to self-care, Tom opens up about the routines that help him switch off, stay healthy, and navigate life in the spotlight.

He also talks about the value of honest friends, the importance of daily exercise, and why he wishes he'd travelled more when he was younger.
